experiment: C1 compiler benchmark and paired CE topology replication
evidence_tier: Exploratory: original substitution final test has already been inspected
ce_priority: Paired real CE / rewired CE for each seed; seed-zero original checkpoint reused; seeds 1-4 are fresh replications
hard_target_rule: Generate autoregressively from training prompts only; training loss receives exclusively teacher-generated responses; evaluate on unchanged original held-out labels
hard_equivalence_rule: Run C1 seed zero independently. If all training targets and every model/optimizer/RNG tensor equal CE-only, document exact relabeling equivalence rather than spending on redundant deterministic reruns. Otherwise complete all five hard-label seeds.

tournament.curriculum: alpha decreases linearly from 1 at update 1 to 0.5 at update 1024; temperature 2
tournament.hidden_alignment: Hard-target CE plus weight-1 mean squared distance between L2-normalized learned projection of output-population states and frozen final teacher representations, at response prediction positions; projection discarded for inference
tournament.relational_alignment: Separate matched batch-2 cohort: hard-target CE plus weight-1 squared difference of cross-example cosine similarity of output-population and teacher representations at each response prediction position; no auxiliary readout; 512 updates / 1024 examples
tournament.selection: Freeze all methods before training; select highest full-validation exact accuracy among batch-1 temperature/curriculum/hidden candidates, break ties by response CE then method name, before evaluating any candidate on final test; all candidates receive equal training and are reported
tournament.replication: Replicate the validation-selected batch-1 method on seeds 1-4, regardless of effect sign. Replicate relational batch-2 cohort on seeds 1-4 only if validation exact accuracy exceeds its hard-target control; report adaptive selection explicitly.
tournament.no_escalation: Do not launch harder tasks or change data, final test, architecture, LR, budget, or stopping rule based on these results

match_interpretation: Exploratory descriptive parity target; not a statistically established noninferiority margin
primary: Compiled minus CE-only exact accuracy, paired by seed and input; show original seed zero separately from fresh seeds 1-4
topology_control: Real CE versus degree-preserving rewired CE with matched seeds, data order, I/O populations, optimizer and 1024 updates
artifact_policy: All checkpoints and optimizer/RNG states on Seagate with hashes; code, specs, per-instance results and reports pushed to GitHub; checkpoint symlinks after archived verification limit internal-disk usage
